heading: Your classes
lead: Share lessons with a class. Pupils open a link or type a code. They don't sign in, and we store nothing about them.
signInFirst: Sign in with an adult account to use teaching tools.
enableText: For adults aged 18 or over with a confirmed email address.
nameHint: For example "SSS2 Physics". Don't use pupils' names.
codeText: Share this link or code with your class. It's shown only now. If you lose it, make a new one.
noLessons: No lessons yet. Add one from your saved lessons.
noSaved: Save a lesson to your account first, then add it here.
newCodeHint: The old link stops working straight away.
archivedText: Archived on {date}. It is deleted 30 days later unless you restore it.
joinLead: Type the code your teacher gave you. You don't need an account.
classEmpty: Your teacher hasn't added any lessons yet.
classPrivacy: Using a class link stores nothing about you.
classTutorOff: Your teacher has turned the tutor off for this class.
summaryLead: Counts for the whole class by week. Any number under {min} is shown as "fewer than {min}", so no pupil can be picked out. There is no view of single pupils.
summaryEmpty: Nothing yet. Counts appear once pupils open the class's lessons.
